title: Orchestrated staged rollup with preflight simulations for private control plane upgrades
creator: Avery Chen
description: Build an automated staged rollup workflow for private (VPC) control plane version upgrades that emphasizes preflight simulation, non-invasive compatibility checks, and deterministic rollback. Deliverables: Terraform/IaC module changes to orchestrate stage cohorts, a preflight simulator that runs smoke/canary workloads against a cloned control plane, health-gate definitions and probes, and an automated rollback plan with safety contracts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Terraform module supports staged promotion and can create ephemeral preview control planes for preflight runs. 2) Preflight simulator runs a configurable test plan (API smoke, reconciliation, lease/leader failover, common operator CRs) and produces a pass/fail health report. 3) Promotion will only proceed if health gates pass and SLA regression delta is within thresholds. 4) On FAIL, orchestrator triggers automated rollback and produces diagnostics artifacts (logs, metrics snapshots, snapshot of Jobs/Pods).
comments: 2025-02-11 - Avery Chen: Kickoff sync happened. Agreed scope: preflight sims must be non-disruptive to live tenants. Marco to prototype ephemeral control plane cloning using Terraform workspace + lightweight kubeadm-like bootstrap; Est 8 points.

2025-02-14 - Marco Alvarez: Prototype succeeded for small cluster (3-node) using terraform workspaces and a temporary route table in VPC. Created a simple harness that replays API calls from recorded traffic to the preview control plane. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane-ops/pull/478. Observed 12% extra CPU during simulation; noted we need rate-limiting on replay to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

2025-02-18 - Design review (internal): PM requested clearer UX for rollup cohorts and visibility into which tenants are in each stage. Added task to console team to add cohort labels and per-tenant trial toggles (logged as PM-402).

2025-02-21 - SRE feedback: Health gates should include reconciliation latency, failed webhook rate, KV cache hit ratio, and control-plane API success rate. Also requested synthetic leader failover test. Added to test plan.

2025-02-25 - Marco Alvarez: Implemented health-gate evaluator and threshold config. Built exporter to snapshot metrics at T0 and Tn and calculate deltas. Ran simulated promotion against canary cohort of internal tenants: reconciliation latency increased by 18% but still under target; however, webhook error rate spiked for one operator. Marked as FAIL and aborted promotion flow. Root cause: operator CR schema mismatch with new API. Logged follow-up ENG issue ENG-87901 to patch operator compatibility.

2025-02-28 - Security review (notes): Ephemeral preview control planes must not have access to production secrets. Implemented KMS-scoped keys for previews and enforced IAM boundary. Security approval pending for preview artifact retention policy.

2025-03-03 - Marco Alvarez: Added automated rollback executor that runs in two phases: immediate traffic cut and state-preserving rollback (snapshot CRs then restore). Verified rollback on staging with synthetic tenants. Added detailed diagnostics: etcd snapshot pointer, control plane logs (last 1h), and reconciliation traces for failing controllers.

2025-03-05 - PM check-in (Lena Ortiz): Asked for release gating criteria to be codified in PRD. Also requested runbook for on-call that includes quick triage checklist and how to trigger emergency rollback via CLI and Console. Assigned runbook write-up to Marco.

Next steps: 1) Finish security approval for preview artifacts (Avery). 2) Harden replay harness to apply rate limiting and tenant-scoped replay (Marco). 3) Add console UI flags for staged cohorts and emergency rollback button (PM + Console). 4) Schedule cross-team dry-run with SRE, platform, and ops (target 2025-03-18).
